title: Ship Trigger
description: Schema for .ship/triggers/*.jsonc — a reactive trigger that subscribes to an event and runs actions. The actions[] type vocabulary is a CLOSED ENUM at v1: collection.insert, collection.update, event.emit, pipeline.trigger. Adding a new action type is a coordinated change across this schema, the loader (crates/core/runtime/src/hooks/), and a Reference page; unknown types are rejected at load time.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Set to this schema's $id for editor validation.

name.description: Unique trigger identifier within the project.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this trigger does.

trigger.description: The event subscription or external source this trigger listens on.

event.description: Internal event type to match (e.g. 'job.failed'). Mutually exclusive with 'source'.

source.description: External trigger source. Mutually exclusive with 'event'.

oneOf.title: webhook
oneOf.description: Fires when an HTTP POST arrives at the registered path.

secret.description: Verified against X-Ship-Webhook-Secret header. Use 'env:VAR_NAME' to read from environment.

oneOf.title: file
oneOf.description: Fires when a filesystem event matches the watched path or glob.

watch.description: Path or glob to watch. Relative paths resolve from the project root.

events.description: Event kinds to react to. Defaults to all three if omitted.

debounce_ms.description: Coalescing debounce in milliseconds. Defaults to 200.

expression.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (min hour dom month dow). Seconds field optional as prefix.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Defaults to UTC.

filter.description: Optional dot-path filter on the event payload. Trigger runs only when the filter evaluates to a truthy value.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to run when the trigger fires. CLOSED ENUM at v1: each action's `type` must be one of collection.insert, collection.update, event.emit, pipeline.trigger. The oneOf below is exhaustive; unknown action types fail validation.

when.description: Jinja expression. Action is skipped when this evaluates to falsy.

oneOf.title: collection.insert
oneOf.description: Insert a new item into a collection.

data.description: Item data to insert. May use Jinja template expressions.

template_file.description: Path relative to .ship/ of a Jinja template that renders the item data JSON.

oneOf.title: collection.update
oneOf.description: Update items in a collection that match a filter.

filter.description: Filter object to select items to update.

data.description: Partial item data to merge. May use Jinja template expressions.

oneOf.title: event.emit
oneOf.description: Emit a derived event through the kernel.

payload.description: Payload to attach. May use Jinja template expressions.

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the pipeline.
